response.rationale: R6 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including the presence of purpuric retiform patches, diffuse papules, and Gram-positive cocci in vessels, which are all consistent with Purpura Fulminans. R2 is the runner-up because it also has strong support from the vignette, including the presence of Gram-positive cocci in vessels and cavitary lesions in lungs, but it does not account for the skin manifestations as well as R6 does.
